# Logitech's MX Master 3S Bluetooth mouse drops to just $80, matching its all-time low

 By XDA Deals Desk 

 Published Nov 17, 2026, 2:18 PM EST 

If you spend your day in spreadsheets, browser tabs, and video calls, a quiet, precise mouse is one of the easiest desk upgrades to appreciate. That's where the Logitech MX Master 3S Bluetooth Wireless Mouse comes in—it's on sale at Amazon for $79.99, matching its all-time low at the retailer.

##### Logitech MX Master 3S 

 Weight 

 141 g 

 Sensor 

 Darkfield high-precision sensor 

 Battery 

 ~70 days 

 Maximum DPI 

 8000 

The MX Master 3S is an excellent mouse if you want to amp up your productivity. It offers multiple programmable buttons, Logitech's MagSpeed scroll wheel, multi-device support, an ergonomic design, and more.

## Comfortable ergonomics for a fair price 

Credit: Logitech

 The 8,000DPI optical sensor tracks on most surfaces, including glass that's at least 4mm thick, so you're not tied to one spot on your desk. That's handy if your desk or table has a glass top, as long as the glass meets that 4mm minimum. You can also adjust the sensitivity in Logi Options+ if you'd rather have the cursor move faster or slower.

Logitech says its clicks are 90% quieter than those on the older MX Master 3, which matters if you share an office with others. The MagSpeed electromagnetic scroll wheel is machined steel and nearly silent, and Logitech says it can scroll up to 1,000 lines per second, so long spreadsheets and web pages fly by when you give it a spin.

The Logi Options+ app is available on Windows and macOS, and it includes specific customizations for Chrome, Safari, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Zoom, Teams, and Microsoft Office. You can also tune how the mouse behaves exactly you need in the programs you use most.

However, there are a couple of things worth knowing first. The listing is marked with "No Receiver," essentially meaning you won't get a Bluetooth dongle to plug into your PC. Make sure you can connect with Bluetooth without a dongle before picking this up. Also, if you already own an MX Master 3, the quieter clicks are the main difference here, so weigh that against the price before you upgrade.

At $80, the Logitech MX Master 3S is a solid pick if you want a quieter, more customizable mouse for desk work, and it's $20 under its regular price at Amazon. Between the sensor, the near-silent scroll wheel, and the Quiet Clicks, you're getting a well-rounded mouse for the money.
